name: Hronaut
description: Visible desktop browser for coding agents, with persistent named Chromium workspaces and local/loopback Streamable HTTP MCP access. People can pause MCP and take over. Windows, macOS and Linux. Includes Hronaut-owned wallet providers in preview for supervised dApp QA. Source-available; one 10-day trial from the first agent tool call, then $4/month or $24/year per named user, up to three active devices. Not a hosted browser service.
